materials.title: At the Bicycle Workshop — 1
materials.text:
First sentence: I arranged for a mechanic to replace my worn brake cables yesterday.
Second sentence: I ____ yesterday.
Key word: HAD

questions.prompt: Complete sentence 1 using HAD. Write only the missing words.
acceptedAnswers: had my worn brake cables replaced

rejectedAnswers: had my worn brake cables repair

questions.explanation: have something done表示安排他人完成维修；此处保留过去时和被更换的刹车线。repair缺少被动分词形式，不能接在该结构中。

materials.title: At the Bicycle Workshop — 2
materials.text:
First sentence: You must not ride this bicycle under any circumstances.
Second sentence: Under ____ this bicycle.
Key word: CIRCUMSTANCES

questions.prompt: Complete sentence 2 using CIRCUMSTANCES. Write only the missing words.
acceptedAnswers: no circumstances are you to ride
questions.explanation: 否定短语under no circumstances前置时，后面使用must you ride的部分倒装；保持绝对禁止骑行的含义，不能变成肯定的any circumstances。

materials.title: At the Bicycle Workshop — 3
materials.text:
First sentence: We have not received the replacement axle yet.
Second sentence: We ____ the replacement axle.
Key word: YET

questions.prompt: Complete sentence 3 using YET. Write only the missing words.
questions.explanation: have yet to do表示到目前仍未完成，保留尚未收到车轴的含义。to后应接动词原形receive；received of不是可接受的补语结构。

materials.title: At the Bicycle Workshop — 4
materials.text:
First sentence: The mechanic deliberately checks the serial number before every repair.
Second sentence: The mechanic ____ the serial number before every repair.
Key word: POINT

questions.prompt: Complete sentence 4 using POINT. Write only the missing words.
acceptedAnswers: makes it a point to check
questions.explanation: make a point of doing强调有意识地坚持做某事，对应每次维修前刻意核对序列号。of后接动名词，to checking在此结构中错误。

materials.title: At the Bicycle Workshop — 5
materials.text:
First sentence: There is no point in repairing this badly bent rim.
Second sentence: This badly bent rim ____.
Key word: WORTH

questions.prompt: Complete sentence 5 using WORTH. Write only the missing words.
questions.explanation: not worth doing表示不值得进行这项修理，与there is no point in repairing对应。worth后接动名词repairing，不能接to repair。

materials.title: At the Bicycle Workshop — 6
materials.text:
First sentence: The locked tool cabinet stopped the children from reaching the solvent.
Second sentence: The locked tool cabinet ____ the solvent.
Key word: PREVENTED

questions.prompt: Complete sentence 6 using PREVENTED. Write only the missing words.
questions.explanation: prevent somebody from doing表示阻止某人接触溶剂，与stopped的过去事件一致。from在标准表达中可保留，英式英语也可省略；两种有效形式均接纳。to reaching仍破坏该动词的补语结构。

materials.title: A Small Cinema — 1
materials.text:
First sentence: The seats sold so quickly that extra screenings were arranged.
Second sentence: So ____ that extra screenings were arranged.
Key word: QUICKLY

questions.prompt: Complete sentence 1 using QUICKLY. Write only the missing words.
questions.explanation: So加副词置于句首形成结果结构时，使用did the seats sell倒装，并以动词原形sell接在did后。原句的售票速度和加场结果均保留。

materials.title: A Small Cinema — 2
materials.text:
First sentence: Without the equipment that the volunteers lent us, the screening would have been impossible.
Second sentence: ____ the volunteers' equipment, the screening would have been impossible.
Key word: FOR

questions.prompt: Complete sentence 2 using FOR. Write only the missing words.
acceptedAnswers: if it had not been for
questions.explanation: Had it not been for相当于If it had not been for，表达过去的反事实条件：若没有志愿者设备就无法放映。if it not been for缺少所需助动词。

materials.title: A Small Cinema — 3
materials.text:
First sentence: The manager assumes without questioning it that all viewers will read the warnings.
Second sentence: The manager ____ all viewers will read the warnings.
Key word: GRANTED

questions.prompt: Complete sentence 3 using GRANTED. Write only the missing words.
questions.explanation: take it for granted that表示把从句内容视为理所当然，保留经理未经质疑就作出假定的含义。形式宾语it必须位于takes之后。

materials.title: A Small Cinema — 4
materials.text:
First sentence: This film is much longer than any other film the director has made.
Second sentence: This is ____ the director has ever made.
Key word: FAR

questions.prompt: Complete sentence 4 using FAR. Write only the missing words.
acceptedAnswers: far and away the longest film
questions.explanation: by far加强最高级，the longest film对应比导演其他所有影片都长得多。more与longest叠加不成立，也不能用比较级替代最高级范围。

materials.title: A Small Cinema — 5
materials.text:
First sentence: The projector started working again only after a second technician arrived.
Second sentence: It ____ arrived that the projector started working again.
Key word: UNTIL

questions.prompt: Complete sentence 5 using UNTIL. Write only the missing words.
acceptedAnswers: was not until a second technician

rejectedAnswers: was until not a second technician

questions.explanation: It was not until...that是强调时间起点的结构，对应only after第二位技师到场才恢复。not必须紧邻was之后并在until之前。

materials.title: A Small Cinema — 6
materials.text:
First sentence: The assistant said that she would prefer not to discuss the ending at that moment.
Second sentence: The assistant said, "I ____ ending at the moment."
Key word: RATHER

questions.prompt: Complete sentence 6 using RATHER. Write only the missing words.
acceptedAnswers: would rather not talk about the
questions.explanation: would rather not加动词原形，表示当时不愿讨论结局，保留原句的偏好而非改为禁止。discussing不能直接作would rather后的谓语。

materials.title: A Walking Rescue — 1
materials.text:
First sentence: The team was just about to abandon the search when a whistle sounded.
Second sentence: The team ____ abandoning the search when a whistle sounded.
Key word: VERGE

questions.prompt: Complete sentence 1 using VERGE. Write only the missing words.
acceptedAnswers: was right on the verge of
questions.explanation: be on the verge of doing表示即将做某事，保留听见哨声前差一点放弃搜寻的时间关系。固定介词为on，不是in。

materials.title: A Walking Rescue — 2
materials.text:
First sentence: The locked gate meant that we could not get into the hut.
Second sentence: The locked gate meant that we ____ the hut.
Key word: ACCESS

questions.prompt: Complete sentence 2 using ACCESS. Write only the missing words.
questions.explanation: gain access to表示进入或获得通行，could not保留当时无法进入小屋的事实。access在此搭配to，不能用at替代。

materials.title: A Walking Rescue — 3
materials.text:
First sentence: Only after the last walker had been found did the rescuers leave.
Second sentence: The rescuers ____ the last walker had been found.
Key word: UNTIL

questions.prompt: Complete sentence 3 using UNTIL. Write only the missing words.
questions.explanation: not leave until对应直到找到最后一位徒步者才离开。助动词did后必须使用leave原形；left不符合时态结构。

materials.title: A Walking Rescue — 4
materials.text:
First sentence: The leader said that she was sure that the team had left the radio at the campsite.
Second sentence: The leader said, "The team ____ at the campsite."
Key word: MUST

questions.prompt: Complete sentence 4 using MUST. Write only the missing words.
acceptedAnswers: must surely have left the radio
questions.explanation: must have加过去分词表达对过去事件的确信推断，对应领队确信无线电落在营地。must后接have而非had。

materials.title: A Walking Rescue — 5
materials.text:
First sentence: Despite the guide's repeated warnings, several walkers took the closed path.
Second sentence: Several walkers took the closed path ____ the guide's repeated warnings.
Key word: SPITE

questions.prompt: Complete sentence 5 using SPITE. Write only the missing words.
questions.explanation: in spite of与despite在这里都表示尽管有反复警告仍走了封闭道路，保留让步关系。固定短语开头为in而非on。

materials.title: A Walking Rescue — 6
materials.text:
First sentence: The new emergency marker helped explain where the route had changed.
Second sentence: The new emergency marker ____ where the route had changed.
Key word: LIGHT

questions.prompt: Complete sentence 6 using LIGHT. Write only the missing words.
questions.explanation: shed light on在这里表示帮助解释路线改变的位置，保留过去时shed。at不能引出该抽象说明对象，也不能替换on。

materials.title: An Orchestra Rehearses — 1
materials.text:
First sentence: The orchestra had not played outdoors at any time before that concert.
Second sentence: The orchestra ____ before that concert.
Key word: NEVER

questions.prompt: Complete sentence 1 using NEVER. Write only the missing words.
questions.explanation: at any time配合过去完成时否定，等于那场音乐会之前从未在户外演奏。保留played，不把首次公开演出偷换成从未户外排练；playing不能接在had never后。

materials.title: An Orchestra Rehearses — 2
materials.text:
First sentence: The conductor does not intend to replace the cellist.
Second sentence: The conductor ____ the cellist.
Key word: INTENTION

questions.prompt: Complete sentence 2 using INTENTION. Write only the missing words.
acceptedAnswers: has no intention whatsoever of replacing
questions.explanation: have no intention of doing对应没有更换大提琴手的打算；of后接replacing。to replacing在这一结构中不合语法。

materials.title: An Orchestra Rehearses — 3
materials.text:
First sentence: The score was so difficult that we changed the rehearsal plan.
Second sentence: It was ____ that we changed the rehearsal plan.
Key word: SUCH

questions.prompt: Complete sentence 3 using SUCH. Write only the missing words.
questions.explanation: such a加形容词和可数名词单数构成结果结构，与so difficult的难度和更改排练计划的结果相同。冠词位置不能放在形容词后。

materials.title: An Orchestra Rehearses — 4
materials.text:
First sentence: The venue was wrong not to tell us about the scheduled power cut.
Second sentence: The venue ____ the scheduled power cut.
Key word: SHOULD

questions.prompt: Complete sentence 4 using SHOULD. Write only the missing words.
questions.explanation: should have told表达过去本该通知但未通知的批评，保留原句对场地方的责任判断。情态动词后不能用had。

materials.title: An Orchestra Rehearses — 5
materials.text:
First sentence: As soon as the conductor entered, the brass section started tuning.
Second sentence: No sooner ____ the brass section started tuning.
Key word: THAN

questions.prompt: Complete sentence 5 using THAN. Write only the missing words.
questions.explanation: No sooner前置使用had加主语加过去分词，并用than连接紧接着发生的事件。entered保留入场已经发生，entering不构成过去完成时。

materials.title: An Orchestra Rehearses — 6
materials.text:
First sentence: You must send the final programme by Friday, whatever happens.
Second sentence: The final programme ____ by Friday, whatever happens.
Key word: FAIL

questions.prompt: Complete sentence 6 using FAIL. Write only the missing words.
questions.explanation: must be sent转换为被动而不改变必须按时发送的要求，without fail强调务必完成。with fail不是该固定表达。

materials.title: In a Cookery Class — 1
materials.text:
First sentence: I would prefer you not to use that pan.
Second sentence: I ____ that pan.
Key word: RATHER

questions.prompt: Complete sentence 1 using RATHER. Write only the missing words.
acceptedAnswers: would rather you did not use

rejectedAnswers: would rather you not to use

questions.explanation: would rather somebody did not do表达对他人当下行为的偏好，过去式表示虚拟而非过去时间。you not to use不是该结构的正确补语。

materials.title: In a Cookery Class — 2
materials.text:
First sentence: The instructor insisted that we wash our hands before making the dough.
Second sentence: The instructor ____ our hands before making the dough.
Key word: INSISTED

questions.prompt: Complete sentence 2 using INSISTED. Write only the missing words.
questions.explanation: insist on后可用our washing，口语也可用us washing，二者均保留要求我们洗手。insisted for不能引出这里的动名词补语。

materials.title: In a Cookery Class — 3
materials.text:
First sentence: It is impossible to reproduce this result without a thermometer.
Second sentence: Reproducing this result without a thermometer ____.
Key word: QUESTION

questions.prompt: Complete sentence 3 using QUESTION. Write only the missing words.
questions.explanation: out of the question在此表示不可能，与缺少温度计就无法复现的条件一致。固定介词of不能替换为from。

materials.title: In a Cookery Class — 4
materials.text:
First sentence: Nobody took any notice of the alarm until the instructor pointed to it.
Second sentence: Nobody ____ the alarm until the instructor pointed to it.
Key word: ATTENTION

questions.prompt: Complete sentence 4 using ATTENTION. Write only the missing words.
questions.explanation: pay attention to对应take notice of，Nobody与any共同保留无人留意警报的否定含义。attention后应接to而非at。

materials.title: In a Cookery Class — 5
materials.text:
First sentence: The chef checked the ovens as a safety measure before leaving.
Second sentence: The chef ____ the ovens before leaving.
Key word: PRECAUTION

questions.prompt: Complete sentence 5 using PRECAUTION. Write only the missing words.
questions.explanation: take the precaution of doing表示作为预防措施而检查，与原句安全核查的目的相同。of后接动名词，to checking不成立。

materials.title: In a Cookery Class — 6
materials.text:
First sentence: This cooling rack is not nearly as stable as the old one.
Second sentence: This cooling rack ____ the old one.
Key word: NEAR

questions.prompt: Complete sentence 6 using NEAR. Write only the missing words.
acceptedAnswers: is nowhere near as stable as
is nowhere near so stable as
isn't anywhere near as stable as
isn't anywhere near so stable as

rejectedAnswers: is nowhere near as stable than

questions.explanation: nowhere near as或so...as表示远不及，保留新架子稳定性较差的比较方向。结尾必须为as；than不能与这里的同级比较结构搭配。

units.instruction: Complete the second sentence so that it means the same as the first. Use the given key word without changing it. Write only 3 to 6 words for the gap, including the key word.
units.alignmentNote: Original source supplies the six-item keyword-transformation format and three-to-six-word bound only. All situations, sentence pairs, keys and rationales are newly authored; no official C1 or learner calibration claimed.

materials.title: A Community Garden — 1
materials.text:
First sentence: Sarah was not convinced that the neglected plot could ever produce enough vegetables.
Second sentence: Sarah ____ the neglected plot could ever produce enough vegetables.
Key word: DOUBTFUL

questions.prompt: Complete sentence 1 using DOUBTFUL. Write only the missing words.
questions.explanation: be doubtful that或whether均表达对产量可能性的怀疑，保留不确信的态度。of不能直接放在that从句前形成of that结构。

materials.title: A Community Garden — 2
materials.text:
First sentence: The donation made it possible for us to replace the broken water tank.
Second sentence: The donation ____ the broken water tank.
Key word: ENABLED

questions.prompt: Complete sentence 2 using ENABLED. Write only the missing words.
questions.explanation: enable somebody to do表示使我们能够更换水箱，对应made it possible。其补语需要to replace，不能用replacing of。

materials.title: A Community Garden — 3
materials.text:
First sentence: Do not promise to share tools unless you really intend to.
Second sentence: Do not ____ unless you really intend to.
Key word: COMMITMENT

questions.prompt: Complete sentence 3 using COMMITMENT. Write only the missing words.
acceptedAnswers: make a commitment to sharing tools
make a commitment to share tools

rejectedAnswers: make a commitment for share tools

questions.explanation: make a commitment可接to sharing tools或to share tools，均表示承诺共享工具。保留unless条件；for share不构成合格补语。

materials.title: A Community Garden — 4
materials.text:
First sentence: I regret not labelling the seeds before putting them away.
Second sentence: If only ____ before putting them away!
Key word: LABELLED

questions.prompt: Complete sentence 4 using LABELLED. Write only the missing words.
acceptedAnswers: I had already labelled the seeds
questions.explanation: If only加过去完成时表达对过去未贴标签的遗憾；had labelled与原句regret not对应。would labelled缺少正确的完成结构。

materials.title: A Community Garden — 5
materials.text:
First sentence: Replacing the broken slabs made the paths safer.
Second sentence: Replacing the broken slabs ____.
Key word: RESULTED

questions.prompt: Complete sentence 5 using RESULTED. Write only the missing words.
acceptedAnswers: resulted in the paths being safer
resulted in making the paths safer
questions.explanation: result in后接结果，safer paths保留铺路板更换后道路更安全的因果方向。result to不是这里的固定搭配。

materials.title: A Community Garden — 6
materials.text:
First sentence: We finished the planting successfully despite the rain.
Second sentence: We ____ planting despite the rain.
Key word: SUCCEEDED

questions.prompt: Complete sentence 6 using SUCCEEDED. Write only the missing words.
questions.explanation: succeed in doing表示成功完成，finishing the planting对应已成功完成种植。in后接动名词，to finishing在该搭配中错误。
